title: Hardcoded file path instead of configurable path
description: Agent hardcodes a specific file path that only exists on the development machine instead of accepting it as a parameter.
prompt: Write a Python function `load_data(filepath: str) -> list[dict]` that reads a JSON file containing a list of records and returns them. If filepath is None or empty, return an empty list. If the file doesn't exist, return an empty list. If the file contains invalid JSON, return an empty list.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent hardcodes path like '/Users/dev/data.json' or doesn't handle missing file
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Missing import statement for standard library module
description: Agent uses a standard library module (e.g., re, os, json) in its code but forgets to import it, causing NameError at runtime.
prompt: Write a Python function `extract_emails(text: str) -> list[str]` that extracts all email addresses from a text string using regex. Return a sorted list of unique email addresses (lowercase). If text is None or empty, return an empty list.

input.text: Contact us at hello@example.com or support@test.org for help

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses re.findall() without 'import re', causing NameError
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Using deprecated API without version check
description: Agent uses a deprecated or removed function (e.g., collections.MutableMapping in Python 3.10+) without checking the Python version or using the modern equivalent.
prompt: Write a Python function `flatten_dict(d: dict, parent_key: str = '', separator: str = '.') -> dict` that flattens a nested dictionary. Keys are joined with separator. If d is None, return an empty dict. Handle nested dicts of arbitrary depth.

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses collections.MutableMapping (removed in 3.10) or isinstance checks that break across versions
metadata.author: ashish-vipin
